title: ROSABELLE
message: The silence was real. The meaning was yours.
meaning:
A rose. A sealed message. An empty chair.

Rosabelle belongs to the hidden Houdini archive. It refers to the attempt to leave behind a recognizable message after death — and to the silence that followed.

It promises nothing supernatural.
mechanic: Secret lore card. It remains absent from the visible collection until discovered and requires the empty chair, the fracture trace and a sufficiently long journey.
